title: Pure Hand
summary: The Hand strategy is Girag's iconic Barian control archetype built on the self-floating destruction loop of Fire Hand and Ice Hand. Crashing Fire Hand destroys an opposing monster to summon Ice Hand from the Deck, which in turn destroys a Spell or Trap to summon Fire Hand. Because both possess exactly 1600 ATK or DEF, any destruction on the field triggers Thunder Hand from the hand or GY to destroy another opponent's card, setting up Rank 4 overlays into Number 106: Giant Hand and the field-negating Rank 5 boss Number C106: Giant Red Hand.

allow.Number 106: Giant Hand: Girag's signature Rank 4 'Hand' Xyz boss that detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect to negate an opponent's monster effect and lock its battle position.
allow.Number C106: Giant Red Hand: Girag's Rank 5 Chaos 'Hand' Xyz boss that detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect when any card/effect is activated to negate the effects of ALL other face-up cards currently on the field!
allow.Seventh Tachyon: Reveals Number 106: Giant Hand in the Extra Deck to search a Level 4 monster, or searches Rank-Up-Magic via Seventh Ascension.
allow.Seventh Ascension: Searches Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force or Seventh Tachyon to rank up Number 106: Giant Hand into Number C106: Giant Red Hand.
allow.Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force: Upgrades Rank 4 Number 106: Giant Hand into Rank 5 Number C106: Giant Red Hand.
allow.Supply Squad: Continuous Spell that draws 1 card every turn when Fire Hand or Ice Hand is destroyed by battle or card effect.
allow.Torrential Tribute: Destroys all monsters on the field when a monster is summoned, destroying your 1600 ATK/DEF Hand monster to immediately trigger Thunder Hand from hand or GY.
allow.Tornado Dragon: Rank 4 Xyz made with any two Level 4 Hands that pops backrow as a Quick Effect.
allow.Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired T: Rank 4 stall boss made with two Level 4 Hands that forces monsters to Defense Position and negates their activated effects.
allow.Castel, the Skyblaster Musketeer: Rank 4 Xyz that detaches 2 materials to spin any face-up card into the Deck.
allow.Time Thief Redoer: Rank 4 Xyz that attaches cards from the opponent's Deck and provides quick-effect banish disruption.

main: Fire Hand

Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1600 ATK / 1000 DEF): when destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to the GY, destroys 1 monster they control and Special Summons Ice Hand from your Deck; its 1600 original ATK satisfies Thunder Hand!
Ice Hand

Level 4 WATER Aqua (1400 ATK / 1600 DEF): when destroyed by an opponent's card and sent to the GY, destroys 1 Spell/Trap they control and Special Summons Fire Hand from your Deck; its 1600 original DEF satisfies Thunder Hand!
Thunder Hand

Level 4 LIGHT Thunder (1600 ATK / 1600 DEF): Quick Effect when a face-up monster(s) you control with 1600 original ATK or DEF is destroyed by battle or card effect: Special Summons itself from hand OR GY and destroys 1 card your opponent controls!
Prominence Hand

Level 4 FIRE Pyro (600 ATK / 2000 DEF): Special Summons itself from your hand while you control a 'Magic Hand', 'Fire Hand', or 'Ice Hand', providing an instant Rank 4 Xyz Summon into Number 106: Giant Hand.
Magic Hand

Level 4 DARK Spellcaster (800 ATK / 1600 DEF): when your opponent adds a card(s) from their Deck to their hand (except by drawing), immediately sends that card(s) to the GY and inflicts 800 burn damage; has 1600 DEF for Thunder Hand!
Seventh Ascension
Searches Seventh Tachyon or Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force to access Girag's Giant Hand Xyz bosses.
Seventh Tachyon
Reveals Number 106: Giant Hand to search a Level 4 starter.
Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force
Ranks up Number 106: Giant Hand into Number C106: Giant Red Hand and steals an opponent's Xyz Material.
Supply Squad
Draws 1 card once per turn whenever Fire Hand or Ice Hand crashes in battle or is destroyed by Torrential Tribute.
Torrential Tribute
Wipes the field on summon and destroys your 1600 ATK/DEF Hand monster to immediately trigger Thunder Hand from your hand or GY.
